## `create_github_project`

*Available in [Python](#create_github_project-python), [CLI](#create_github_project-cli)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Creates a new CIDA project with GitHub integration.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    create_github_project(
        project_name: str | None = None,
        repository_name: str | None = None,
        project_root: Path | None = None,
        template_name: str | None = None,
        principal_investigator: str | None = None,
        analyst: str | list[str] | None = None,
        data_location: str | None = None,
        description: str | None = None,
        visibility: Literal = 'internal'
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project_name` (`str | None`) - A name for the new project.
    - `repository_name` (`str | None`) - An optional name for the repository.
    If none is specified, the name of the `project_root` directory will be used.
    - `project_root` (`Path | None`) - The (local) root directory for the project.
    - `template_name` (`str | None`) - The name of a template project to use.
    To see available templates, call list_github_templates().
    - `principal_investigator` (`str | None`) - 
    - `analyst` (`str | list[str] | None`) - 
    - `data_location` (`str | None`) - 
    - `description` (`str | None`) - An optional description for the repository. (default: None)
    - `visibility` (`Literal`) - The visibility for the repository (default: 'internal')

    <h4>Returns `CIDAProject | None`</h4>

    A CIDAProject instance if project creation was successful, otherwise None.

=== "CLI"
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```shell
    usage: [0m[1;35mcidatools create[0m [[32m-h[0m] [[36m--template [33mTEMPLATE[0m] [[36m--description [33mDESCRIPTION[0m]
                     [[36m--repo-name [33mREPO_NAME[0m]
                     [[36m--create-folders [33mCREATE_FOLDERS [CREATE_FOLDERS ...][0m]
                     [[36m--private[0m | [36m--internal[0m] [[36m--project-name [33mPROJECT_NAME[0m]
                     [[36m--analyst [33mANALYST [ANALYST ...][0m] [[36m--pi [33mPI [PI ...][0m]
                     [[36m--data-location [33mDATA_LOCATION[0m]
                     [[36m--git-location [33mGIT_LOCATION[0m]
                     [32m{github-project,github-repo,project}[0m [32mdirectory[0m

    ```

## `create_local_project`

*Available in [Python](#create_local_project-python), [CLI](#create_local_project-cli)*
=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Creates a CIDA project structure at `project_root`.

    This function operates offline, does not configure an associated GitHub repository, and uses the basic/default project template.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    create_local_project(
        project_root: Path | None = None,
        project_name: str | None = None,
        principal_investigator: str | None = None,
        analyst: str | list[str] | None = None,
        data_location: str | None = None,
        git_location: str | None = None,
        folders_to_create: list[str] | None = None
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project_root` (`Path | None`) - The root directory for the project. defaults to the current working directory.
    - `project_name` (`str | None`) - 
    - `principal_investigator` (`str | None`) - 
    - `analyst` (`str | list[str] | None`) - 
    - `data_location` (`str | None`) - 
    - `git_location` (`str | None`) - 
    - `folders_to_create` (`list[str] | None`) - A list of folders to create as part of the project.
    If not specified, uses CIDA_PROJECT_DEFAULT_FOLDERS

    <h4>Returns `CIDAProject`</h4>

    A CIDAProject object.

=== "CLI"
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```shell
    usage: [0m[1;35mcidatools create[0m [[32m-h[0m] [[36m--template [33mTEMPLATE[0m] [[36m--description [33mDESCRIPTION[0m]
                     [[36m--repo-name [33mREPO_NAME[0m]
                     [[36m--create-folders [33mCREATE_FOLDERS [CREATE_FOLDERS ...][0m]
                     [[36m--private[0m | [36m--internal[0m] [[36m--project-name [33mPROJECT_NAME[0m]
                     [[36m--analyst [33mANALYST [ANALYST ...][0m] [[36m--pi [33mPI [PI ...][0m]
                     [[36m--data-location [33mDATA_LOCATION[0m]
                     [[36m--git-location [33mGIT_LOCATION[0m]
                     [32m{github-project,github-repo,project}[0m [32mdirectory[0m

    ```

## `create_project`

*Available in [R](#create_project-r), [Python](#create_project-python), [CLI](#create_project-cli)*
=== "R"
    <h4>Description</h4>

    This function creates the standard project organization structure for CIDA
    within a folder that already exists.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    create_project(
      project_root = NULL,
      project_name = NULL,
      pi = NULL,
      analyst = NULL,
      data_location = NULL,
      git_location = NULL
    )

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project_name` - Name of project, (required)
    - `pi` - Name of PI and credentials, or "" for blank
    - `analyst` - Name of Analyst(s), (required)
    - `data_location` - Location of project on CIDA Drive, or "" for blank
    - `git_location` - Location project on GitHub
    - `path` - Where should they be created? Default is the working directory.
    - `template` - Which subdirectories to create

    <h4>Returns</h4>

    This function creates the desired project subdirectories and readmes,
     as well as a standard .gitignore file files. It will not overwrite the file
     however if it does not exist. It does not return anything.


    <h4>See Also</h4>

    proj_setup() is the internal wrapper for this that gets called when
     using the RStudio GUI to create a project

=== "Python"
    <h4>Description</h4>
    Interactive flow for creating a CIDA project.

    This function will guide users through the interactive process for creating a new CIDA project which involves:
    1. Choosing whether to create a local project or a GitHub project.
    2. (If GitHub project)
        a. Choosing the project template (template repository)
        b. Providing a GitHub repository name.

    For non-interactive project creation (for use in a script, etc.) use `create_project_local()` or `create_project_github()`.
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```python
    create_project(
        project_path: Path | None = None
    )
    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `project_path` (`Path | None`) - Path to the directory where the project will be created, or None.

    <h4>Returns `CIDAProject | None`</h4>



=== "CLI"
    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```shell
    usage: [0m[1;35mcidatools create[0m [[32m-h[0m] [[36m--template [33mTEMPLATE[0m] [[36m--description [33mDESCRIPTION[0m]
                     [[36m--repo-name [33mREPO_NAME[0m]
                     [[36m--create-folders [33mCREATE_FOLDERS [CREATE_FOLDERS ...][0m]
                     [[36m--private[0m | [36m--internal[0m] [[36m--project-name [33mPROJECT_NAME[0m]
                     [[36m--analyst [33mANALYST [ANALYST ...][0m] [[36m--pi [33mPI [PI ...][0m]
                     [[36m--data-location [33mDATA_LOCATION[0m]
                     [[36m--git-location [33mGIT_LOCATION[0m]
                     [32m{github-project,github-repo,project}[0m [32mdirectory[0m

    ```
